          Purpose:       This document clarifies that Reference Standard 16 pertaining to the installation of drywells for the
                         onsite disposal of storm water shall remain in effect following the effective date of the 2008 New York
                         City Construction Codes.

      BE R

 AC 28-103.20 provides that:
     D FO


           “Rules promulgated by the department in accordance with the law in effect prior to the effective date of this
           code shall remain in effect for the matters covered to the extent that such rules are not inconsistent with
           this code unless and until such rules are amended or repealed by the department.”

 Therefore the matters related to drywells covered in Reference Standard (RS) 16 of the 1968 Building Code shall
 remain in effect and shall be applicable to the installation of drywells for the onsite disposal of storm water, whether
   LE LY




 filed under the 1968 Building Code or the 2008 New York City Construction Codes:
